verdict.rationale: The API reference lives under developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2/, which implies it is generated from an OpenAPI spec covering many endpoints. However, no evidence shows a downloadable spec file. Probes of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404, so the machine-readable spec cannot be confirmed as obtainable. Missing for 10: a documented download link or URL for the OpenAPI JSON/YAML, confirmation that the spec is publicly fetchable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
